name_input: Mechatronics Control Equipments India Pvt. Ltd
export_evidence: No export record found. The only populated customs page (importkey.com/countries/india/mechatronics-control-equipments-india-private-limited, 673 records detected) shows exclusively INBOUND cargo, e.g. exact line: "2025-09-27 | MHA ZENTGRAF GMBH AND CO KG | MECHATRONICS CONTROL EQUIPMENTS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ... FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY | CHENNAI AIR CARGO, India | 84818090 | 1827477" and "2025-09-27 | HENGONG PRECISION EQUIPMENT CO LIMITED | ... SHANGHAI, CHINA | CHENNAI SEA, India | 73251000 | 6919476". Direction is Germany/China -> India, i.e. this company is the importer/buyer, not the shipper. The export-slug variant (importkey.com/countries/india/mechatronics-control-equipments-india-pvt-ltd-export) returned an empty shell: "Loading..." with zero rows. Source counter: ImportKey claims 673 shipments / 2 trading partners / 4 ports; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 import rows, 0 export rows. No bill-of-lading record with an Indian-origin port and a foreign destination was seen for this entity.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Searches for "Mechatronics Control Equipments India" + GST/GeM/tender returned no relevant hits (DuckDuckGo/searx backend refused connection; Bing returned only generic 'mechatronics' dictionary/college pages; Google served a redirect interstitial). The ImportKey buyer-side table lists US consignees (BAILEY INTERNATIONAL LLC, SAVANNAH/TIMKEN, OAKLAND, RENO DISTRIBUTION, KANSAS CITY) but these are aggregated multi-supplier buyer pages, not attributable shipments by this company, so they are not counted as evidence. Domestic supply: null / not public in the sources reachable.
note: Import activity is real and documented (5 dated import rows, latest 2025-09-27, ports Chennai Air Cargo and Chennai Sea, HS 84818090 and 73251000), which proves the entity is an operating importer of valves, ductile cast iron bar and hydraulic components from Germany, China, Italy and Taiwan. However, per Rule 5, imports are not shipments by this supplier: no export consignment and no domestic supply record was found, so the honest verdict is 'следов поставок не найдено' on both the export and the domestic side. Declared HS 841221 (hydraulic power engines/motors) does not match any observed customs line (84818090 valves, 73251000 cast iron articles) - this is an HS observation only, not a rejection ground per Rule 3; the actual codes seen are 84818090 and 73251000. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). PAN AAFCM8186P and state Tamil Nadu were not independently verified in this pass (registries out of scope). No sanctions/court data checked - not a rejection criterion per Rule 2.
